relations.subject: fts:zap-file-format
relations.evidence: Each _Scorch_\-index partition is represented by a _Zap_ file, which is located in the `store` sub-directory for the partition

notable_absence.finding: The page never states whether Zap is itself a version-numbered format (the footer command's output includes a 'Version: 11' field in the worked example, implying Zap files carry their own internal format version) or how many Zap-format versions Server 8.0 has shipped - a detail an engineer author would consider obvious from working with the format daily but which a reader inspecting an old Zap file might need.

cross_component_finding: Six of this page's seven commands (dict, docvalues, stored, explore, fields, footer) are genuinely Zap-specific with no equivalent on the Moss or Scorch pages - operating at a lower level (raw dictionary offsets, vellum byte dumps, doc-value chunk counts) than any Moss/Scorch command. This confirms Zap is a distinct, lower-level on-disk format nested inside Scorch rather than a renaming of Scorch itself - the three cbft-bleve child pages (Moss, Scorch, Zap) each have substantial unique content once the one shared boilerplate paragraph (flagged in the sibling records) is set aside.
